name: BÄR Automation ConTrax Module One
summary: A German modular mobile manipulator: an omnidirectional, SLAM-navigated AGV platform (up to 500 kg load) carrying a supply station with battery and controller on which a lightweight cobot arm of the customer's choice is mounted, for indoor transport and picking tasks.

germany.statusNote: Built and sold by BÄR Automation GmbH in Gemmingen (Baden-Württemberg); the product page has a "Jetzt anfragen" / "Angebot anfordern" enquiry form, no public price. Agile Robots (Munich) names it as a mobile manipulator it develops with BÄR Automation and idealworks.

sellers.name: BÄR Automation GmbH
sellers.note: Enquiry form on the product page (subject "Angebot anfordern"); address Gottlieb-Daimler-Str. 6, 75050 Gemmingen.

specs.label: Max. load (platform)
specs.quote: Max. Zuladung: 500 kg (Tragkraft Erweiterung optional möglich)

specs.label: Navigation
specs.value: SLAM (free navigation), optional optical fine positioning

specs.label: Speed
specs.conditions: main direction; up to 0.6 m/s omnidirectional, up to 0.3 m/s when picking up a load

specs.label: Energy
specs.value: LiFePO4 battery 48 V, 42 Ah; stationary inductive charging
specs.quote: Energiemanagement: LiFePO Batterie (48 V, 42 Ah), Induktives Ladesystem (stationär)

specs.label: Safety
specs.value: 2 SICK safety laser scanners, emergency stop, safety controller
specs.quote: Safety: 2 SICK Personenschutz Laserscanner, Not Halt Taster, Sicherheitssteuerung

specs.label: Robot arm
specs.value: Lightweight robot arms of various makers can be fitted to the robot module
specs.quote: Das Robotermodul lässt sich mit Leichtbaurobotersystemen verschiedener Hersteller kombinieren

notes: The cobot arm and gripper are chosen per project; arm payload depends on the arm fitted.
The battery, charger and robot controller sit in a supply station under the arm, so the arm module can also be moved on a passive platform without drive.
Maker states indoor industrial use only.
